study_scope: One simulated study links the hero result to residual and sensitivity evidence.

records.hero: Algorithm performance at five evaluation checkpoints
records.residual: Residual values for the proposed and adaptive methods
records.sensitivity: One-parameter response values used as supporting evidence

units.x: checkpoint or parameter value as indicated by record_type
units.y: normalized performance or residual as indicated by record_type

transformations: Sorted each panel by its x or parameter coordinate; no smoothing or data deletion.
